repo.description:
## Impact

A path traversal vulnerability in Discourse backup handling could allow an authenticated administrator on one site in a multisite deployment to access backup files belonging to another site when backups are stored locally.

In affected configurations, an admin on Site A could potentially retrieve sensitive backup data from Site B (same host, multisite) by crafting a backup download request with a traversal payload.

## Affected configurations

- Multisite deployments
- backup_location = local

Not affected:

- Deployments using S3 backup storage for backups

## Workarounds

  If you cannot immediately upgrade/patch:

  - Switch backup storage to S3
  - Restrict backup access to trusted operators only
  - Monitor admin backup access logs for suspicious traversal-style requests (for example, encoded ..%2F patterns)
repo.summary: Cross-site backup access via path traversal in multisite local backups
